exercises.name: 체스트프레스 머신
exercises.pose_description: Seated upright against a back pad, feet on floor, pressing two MACHINE handles forward at chest level. Show the seated chest press machine, not a bench or free weights.

exercises.name: 덤벨 레터럴 레이즈
exercises.pose_description: Standing upright, one dumbbell in each hand, lifting arms sideways to shoulder height with slightly bent elbows; weights travel sideways, not forward. Front three-quarter view.

exercises.name: 바벨 로우
exercises.pose_description: Standing with hips hinged and knees slightly bent, torso leaning forward about 45 degrees, both hands pulling a BARBELL toward the lower ribs. No bench or machine. Side three-quarter view.

exercises.name: 사이클
exercises.pose_description: Riding a stationary exercise bicycle, seated on the saddle, feet on pedals, hands on handlebars. Show both wheels or stationary flywheel housing and entire bicycle.
